title: Three Springs and One Short Trowel
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：pear　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pear 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the gardener ① picked the pear that no apprentice in the garden would have noted, and he said the picking was the whole of the spring. The ② pear, meaning the fruit itself and not the trowel, ran three springs and stayed unnoted in the book; a pear, he said, is the only thing in a garden that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ pear in that garden had the same short trowel beside it, and the ④ pear at the far bed, meaning the cutting they kept for the children to plant and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A pear, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the gardener said the noting is the part that fills three springs.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pear was the whole of the matter, meaning the sweetness and not the fruit. The ⑥ pear, meaning the sweetness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; pear, he said, is either something you pick or the only word that means both a fruit and a sweetness. He said the sweetness is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ pear had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short trowel. The ⑧ pear of the whole thing, the gardener wrote in April, was one garden and three springs of noting; pear, he said, is either the cutting at the far bed or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pear I remember is the fruit noted in the notebook, which closed in 1981 and is still noted as the quietest in the garden. A ⑩ pear, my mother said in 1983, is the only fruit that improves by being noted; every pear, she said, is a sweetness that has agreed to look like a fruit. She said the sweetness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 梨（指园子里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 梨（指那个梨本身，与小小的花铲相对）
C. 固定搭配：pick the pear 摘这一个梨
D. n. 梨（指留给孩子们插的那一枝）
E. n. 梨之事（抽象总称，指一处园子的梨之事）
F. n. 梨（指园艺笔记里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 梨、清甜（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 清甜（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: picked the pear that no apprentice in the garden would have noted
The pear, meaning the fruit itself and not the trowel
the pear at the far bed
the pear was the whole of the matter

The pear of the whole thing

answers.why: pick the pear 意为“摘这一个梨”，1974 年那位园丁把园子里没有一位学徒肯记下的一个梨做了一遍。
pear 意为“梨”，指那个梨本身而不是小小的花铲，它经过了三个春天而在簿子上没有被记下。
pear 意为“梨”，指园子里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一把小小的花铲。
pear 意为“梨”，指最远那畦苗床的留给孩子们插的那一枝，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pear 意为“梨、清甜”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个清甜就是那件事的全部。
pear 意为“清甜”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个梨，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pear 意为“梨”，指园艺笔记里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1979 年这一个成了园艺笔记里的一行。
pear 意为“梨之事”，园丁四月写道，整件事的梨之事是一处园子和三个春天的记下。
pear 意为“梨”，我记得的是园艺笔记里记下过的那一个，1981 年栽完了，至今仍被说成园子里最安静的一个。
pear 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，梨是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的梨。
